toolsPreview.name: crawl_website
toolsPreview.description: Crawl a website and extract structured content from all accessible pages. Returns page titles, meta descriptions, headings, body text, internal/external links, and page structure. Use for SEO audits, content inventory, site mapping, or data extraction for analysis.

toolsPreview.name: detect_tech_stack
toolsPreview.description: Identify the technology stack and services used by a website. Returns framework names, CMS platform, JavaScript libraries, analytics services, CDN provider, hosting provider, and security tools detected. Use for competitive analysis, vendor intelligence, or understanding site architecture.

toolsPreview.name: check_dns
toolsPreview.description: Perform DNS lookup to retrieve DNS record details for a domain. Returns A records (IP addresses), MX records (mail servers), CNAME records, NS records (nameservers), and TXT records. Use for email setup verification, DNS troubleshooting, or server infrastructure research.

toolsPreview.name: check_ssl
toolsPreview.description: Inspect SSL/TLS certificate details for a domain. Returns certificate issuer, expiration date, subject alternative names (SANs), key strength, and certificate chain validation status. Use for security audits, certificate renewal tracking, or compliance verification.

toolsPreview.name: lookup_whois
toolsPreview.description: Query WHOIS database for domain registration details. Returns registrant name, registrar, registration and expiration dates, registrant contact info, and nameserver list. Use for domain research, owner identification, or tracking registration status.
